purpose: Domain-owned UI object ids for official BI collage. These ids are the target side of platform actions such as click, hover, select, assertText, assertDisabled, assertNoRequest, and download.
policy: This file names BI official UI objects and their domain semantics; it must not define platform action ids.
Each object may list supported platform actions, but the action definitions live in the platform vocabulary.
Locator hints are domain pack data, not executable helper code.
Testcase-specific expected values belong in testcase/run contracts, not in this vocabulary.

objects.purpose: Logged-in user display button in the app shell.
locatorHints: top-right app shell button containing the expected user display name
hazards: button may be disabled while still valid for display-only observation

objects.purpose: Company shared group in the left BI navigation.
locatorHints: visible text 公司共享
nearest expandable navigation group
hazards: sidebar rerenders after expansion; old element references should be discarded

objects.purpose: Project/report list toolbar download action.
locatorHints: toolbar ordered button index 0
icon-only button above project/report list
hazards: accessible name may be absent; use domain semantic button order when names are unavailable

objects.purpose: Project/report list toolbar delete action.
locatorHints: toolbar ordered button index 1
icon-only button above project/report list
hazards: delete is irreversible and must follow Tool Bridge policy when execution reaches confirm/delete path

objects.purpose: Report-list toolbar create action for adding a report inside the selected collage project.
locatorHints: toolbar ordered button index 2
create/add icon above project/report list
hazards: this creates a report, not a collage project; do not use it for project-limit toast assertions

objects.purpose: Sidebar plus button next to the 拼貼報表 group for creating a collage project.
locatorHints: plus icon aligned with sidebar row text 拼貼報表
same control used by createProject helper
hazards: when project limit is reached, clicking this sidebar plus produces 已達最高5個專案 instead of opening the create-project modal

objects.purpose: Project limit notification after attempting to create over the allowed limit.
locatorHints: toast/status region after create action
body text delta containing project limit message
hazards: toast is transient; evidence must be captured immediately after click

objects.purpose: Row-local delete text action for an individual report in the project/report list.
locatorHints: row operation column text 刪除
row-local action area next to 下載
hazards: row-local delete is clickable and affects that row only; destructive click paths must follow irreversible-action policy

objects.purpose: Tooltip expected after hovering the row-local delete action.
locatorHints: tooltip/popover layer after hover
visible text semantically matching delete
hazards: tooltip is currently a known product gap; absence after real hover is product FAIL evidence for the tooltip testcase

objects.purpose: Report mode selector on the editor/new-report page.
locatorHints: input name=report-mode
radio values mapped by semanticMaps.reportModeRadio

objects.purpose: Collage mode radio option.
locatorHints: report-mode radio value 1
nearest label 拼貼模式
hazards: default state should be observed before any mode switch

objects.purpose: Row-scoped control for choosing a source report.
locatorHints: row-local picker near source/report label
do not use global report text click without row scoping

objects.purpose: Search box inside the source report picker.
locatorHints: input inside opened source report picker
search field visible after picker open
hazards: picker must be open before search input can be observed

objects.purpose: Daily report option inside the source report picker.
locatorHints: option text 每日報表 inside the opened picker

objects.purpose: Row-scoped control for choosing a metric field after source report selection.
locatorHints: row-local field picker after selecting source report

objects.purpose: Calculate/preview button in the editor.

objects.purpose: Validation message after invalid editor action.

objects.purpose: Download-started notification in the editor.
